# i18n-keyless for Go

> Keyless translations for Go servers. `client.T(ctx, "Welcome to our app", lang)` (the source string where a key would go) resolves through the i18n-keyless API: AI translation on the first miss, cached in memory, served from there. One module, standard library only, the semantics of the node SDK.

This file is the whole module documentation as one pasteable Markdown page. The general i18n-keyless documentation (dashboard, MCP server, the JavaScript SDKs) is at https://docs.i18n-keyless.com/llms.txt.

## Install

```bash
go get github.com/arnaudambro/i18n-keyless/ports/go/v3
```

```go
import i18nkeyless "github.com/arnaudambro/i18n-keyless/ports/go/v3"

client, err := i18nkeyless.Init(ctx, i18nkeyless.Config{
	APIKey:    os.Getenv("I18N_KEYLESS_API_KEY"),
	Languages: i18nkeyless.Languages{Primary: "en", Supported: []string{"en", "fr", "es"}},
})
```

Requirements: Go >= 1.21. Module path `github.com/arnaudambro/i18n-keyless/ports/go/v3`, package `i18nkeyless`.

## Use

```go
client.T(ctx, "Welcome to our app", lang)                                                   // a source string: keyless; never fails
client.Translate(ctx, "Welcome to our app", lang)                                           // the same, with the error
client.T(ctx, "Welcome {{name}}", lang, i18nkeyless.WithReplace(map[string]string{"{{name}}": name}))
client.T(ctx, "8 heures", lang, i18nkeyless.WithContext("duration"))                        // stored as "8 heures__duration"
client.T(ctx, "Payer", lang, i18nkeyless.WithNamespace("checkout"))                          // an i18n-keyless namespace
client.T(ctx, "Hola mundo", lang, i18nkeyless.WithOriginLanguage("es"))                     // user generated content
client.T(ctx, "Bonjour", lang, i18nkeyless.WithForceTemporary(map[string]string{"en": "Hi"})) // your own text, stored by the API
client.T(ctx, msg, lang, i18nkeyless.WithNamespace("chat-42"), i18nkeyless.WithUnpersistedNamespace()) // no usage recorded
i18nkeyless.ResolveLang("pt_BR", &i18nkeyless.ResolveOptions{Supported: client.SupportedLanguages(), Fallback: "en"}) // "pt-BR"
client.FlushUsage(ctx); client.Close()                                                       // a script: report usage, stop the timer
```

`T(ctx context.Context, key, lang string, opts ...Option) string`; `Translate` returns `(string, error)`. Options: `WithContext`, `WithNamespace`, `WithReplace`, `WithReplaceOrdered`, `WithForceTemporary`, `WithOriginLanguage`, `WithUnpersistedNamespace`.

## Behaviour

- `Init`: `GET {APIURL}/translate/?last_refresh=` (every language of the default namespace, `&namespace=` when configured), merged into one in-memory map per language. A failed fetch is logged, not returned.
- Primary language: the source string is returned, no lookup, no request.
- Hit: served from memory. Miss: `POST {APIURL}/translate` in the call, body `{key, context?, namespace?, forceTemporary?, languages, primaryLanguage, originLanguage?}` (the default namespace and an origin equal to the primary are omitted); the answer's `data.translation.languages` is cached for every known language and the text for `lang` is returned, else the source text. Concurrent misses of one storage key (and origin) share one request; `forceTemporary` calls are never shared; at most 30 requests in flight.
- When the last in-flight request settles, every namespace that missed is fetched again in the background (`GET /translate/?namespace=`), with the previous `ETag` as `If-None-Match`; `304` keeps the store. Keys are never removed.
- HTTP policy: 10 s timeout per attempt, 3 attempts, backoff 500 ms then 1500 ms on network error, timeout, 429, 5xx; no retry on other 4xx; a 200 with `ok: false` is a failure; never panics; a stored translation is never cleared.
- Headers on every request: `Authorization: Bearer <APIKey>`, `Content-Type: application/json`, `Version: 3.6.1`, `sdk: go` (a server label, counted like `node`). No `unique_id`.
- Usage analytics (node rules): the UTC date each string was last served is recorded per namespace and storage key (`key__context`), the cumulative map is POSTed to `{APIURL}/translate/last-used-translations` as `{primaryLanguage, translationsUsageByNamespace}` at most once every 10 s, from a timer; never cleared; `WithUnpersistedNamespace` calls are not recorded; `DisableUsage` switches it off; `FlushUsage` sends now.
- Custom handlers replace the requests: `HandleTranslate(ctx, key)` (the key only) returns translations by language; `GetAllTranslationsForAllLanguages(ctx)` returns dictionaries by language; `SendTranslationsUsage(ctx, defaultBucket)` receives the default namespace's bucket.

## Configuration (i18nkeyless.Config)

| field | default |
| --- | --- |
| APIKey | none: required unless APIURL, or both HandleTranslate and GetAllTranslationsForAllLanguages, are set |
| APIURL | https://api.i18n-keyless.com |
| Languages.Primary | required, one of the 48 codes |
| Languages.Supported | required, every language the app serves; stored by the API as the project's list |
| DefaultNamespace | default |
| HTTPClient | http.DefaultClient |
| Logger | log.Default() |
| Debug | false |
| DisableUsage | false |
| HandleTranslate, GetAllTranslationsForAllLanguages, SendTranslationsUsage | none |
| OnInit | none |

## Languages

48 codes (`AvailableLangs`): ar, bn, ca, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, hr, cs, da, nl, en, en-GB, fi, fr, fr-CA, de, el, gu, he, hi, hu, id, it, ja, kn, ko, ms, ml, mr, no, or, pl, pt, pt-BR, pa, ro, ru, sk, sl, es, es-MX, sv, ta, te, th, tr, uk, ur, vi. `ResolveLang(tag, opts)`: exact code first (`pt-BR`, any casing, `_` accepted), then Chinese by region (`zh-CN`, `zh-SG` to `zh-Hans`; `zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-MO` to `zh-Hant`; never another script), `es-419` to `es-MX`, then the bare language (`fr-CH` to `fr`); "" when nothing matches and no fallback. `ToAppStoreLocale("fr")` is `fr-FR`. An unknown code passed to `T` renders the source text with no request.

## Limitations

- Dictionaries are flat per language: two namespaces sharing one source text share one entry.
- Misses are deduplicated by storage key and origin language (the SDK queue ignores the context).
- `forceTemporary` in the primary language is sent (the node rule).
- A source string is capped at 2000 characters (`context` and `namespace` at 200). Long-form content is one translation per Markdown block of about 1000 characters, with the same `context` on every block. https://docs.i18n-keyless.com/docs/guides/long-form-content

## API

- `New(cfg) (*Client, error)`, `Init(ctx, cfg) (*Client, error)`.
- `(*Client).T`, `Translate`, `FlushUsage`, `Close`, `SupportedLanguages`, `PrimaryLanguage`.
- Helpers: `StorageKeyFor`, `QueueIDFor`, `ApplyReplace`, `ApplyReplaceOrdered`, `ResolveNamespace`, `ResolveOriginLanguage`, `BuildDictionaryURL`, `EtagCacheKey`, `IsRetryableStatus`, `HTTPErrorMessage`, `DecideStatus`, `DelayAfter`, `IsServerRuntime`, `ResolveLang`, `ToAppStoreLocale`, `IsLang`; constants `Version`, `SDK`, `DefaultAPIURL`, `DefaultNamespace`, `Timeout`, `MaxAttempts`, `RetryDelays`, `AvailableLangs`.
